findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container
findings.comment:
Inspector observed several unlabeled packages of meat throughout freezers in facility. Asked PIC where the meat was from and PIC was able to show inspector bulk shipping containers that contained all relevant safety information for the products. Educated PIC on proper labeling practices. Ensure all produce is labeled before it goes to store shelves. Labels must include: Common name, cooking instructions. Labels can be placed on the outside of the freezer where items are kept or directly on the item.

3-602.11: (A) FOOD PACKAGED in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be properly labeled. (B) Regulatory requirements-(1) The common name of the FOOD/identity statement; 106 (2) List ingredients in descending order of predominance by weight, declaration of artificial colors and flavors and chemical preservatives; (3) net contents; (4) The name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer, or distributor; and (5) MAJOR FOOD ALLERGENS. Pf (6) Nutrition labeling as specified in 21 CFR 101 - Food Labeling and 9 CFR 317 Subpart B Nutrition Labeling UNLESS EXEMPT Under FDCA. (Pf) (C) Bulk FOOD for CONSUMER self-dispensing shall be labeled in plain view. (D) Bulk, unPACKAGED FOODS portioned for CONSUMERS shall be properly labeled.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
Outstanding items from the pre-opening inspection: Seal wall to floors around cooler, and caulk handsink to wall in employee restroom.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). 
Inspector observed raw chicken and raw egg products stored above ready to eat dairy products and gallons of milk. Discussed with staff member at time of inspection. Ensure raw meat and egg products are stored on the lowest shelf, under all other ready to eat foods. Inspector will re-address storage of raw product at follow-up.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment: 3-201.11: FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source. (P) Goat, chicken, and lamb meat in glass-top reach-in freezer observed wrapped in plastic grocery bags/unlabeled plastic wrap. Meat was embargoed at time of inspection and food program supervisor contacted IL Department of Agriculture to come inspect and evaluate meat sales at this facility. Will follow up next week with facility.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment: 3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. Boxes of packaged juice products observed stored out in ambient air in front of counter at the front of the store. According to staff, the product arrived last night. All products bear a label of “keep refrigerated”. Food program supervisor reached out to manufacturers for more information on the product. Tropicana stated the orange and grape juices are to be cold held for safety. Simply Lemonade, apple, orange are also made to be cold held. Items should be discarded by staff after SCDPH speaks to Hani and pulls embargo from the product.
